scoring_justification: The headline HSE06 band gaps and Z2 invariants are produced by DFT simulations; the agent reports final numeric values. The checker cannot recompute the DFT, so it compares the reported values to paper-reported gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported HSE06 system band gaps and Z2 invariants for nine fluoride-terminated MXene compounds, taken from Table II of Phys. Rev. B 102, 075306.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the HSE06 system band gaps (meV) and Z2 topological invariants (all 1) from the paper's published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the peer-reviewed publication; they are not guessed or synthesized.

outputs.description: Compiled HSE06 band gaps and Z₂ topological invariants for the nine M'₂M''C₂F₂ compounds; the checker compares hse06_system_gap and Z2 against hidden reference data.

output_contract.notes: The nine expected compound names are: V2TiC2F2, V2ZrC2F2, V2HfC2F2, Nb2TiC2F2, Nb2ZrC2F2, Nb2HfC2F2, Ta2TiC2F2, Ta2ZrC2F2, Ta2HfC2F2. Lattice constants and PBE gaps are checked for basic plausibility but not strictly scored.

steps.description: Validate Z2==1 and HSE06 system band gaps within tolerances for all nine compounds.
